---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for this marketplace
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ["t: enhancement", "s: triage"]
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature address? Why is it needed?

Describe the challenge or need that this feature addresses.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is your proposal better?

## Use Case

Provide a specific example of how you would use this feature.

**Example:**
```
/git-kit:merge-pr --with-new-feature

# Result: [Expected outcome]
```

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request.

## Implementation Ideas

If you have technical ideas on how to implement this, please share.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing features/components to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have searched existing issues/requests
- [ ] I have clearly defined the problem and use cases

## Would You Contribute?

- [ ] I'd like to work on this feature myself
- [ ] I can help test this feature
- [ ] I'm just suggesting an idea
